    "Simplified project management for financial tasks.",
    "User-friendly interface, especially for those familiar with spreadsheets.",
    "Ability to link multiple Smartsheet documents to a dashboard for oversight."

  "cons": [
    "Friction encountered when updating and transferring data between Excel and Smartsheet.",
    "Limitations in customization options for specific financial reporting needs.",
    "Lack of an auto-save feature can be frustrating during data entry."

  "overall_experience": "This Management Accountant has used Smartsheet for over two years in a large organization, primarily for updating and transferring data with Excel. They likely find its spreadsheet-like interface and project management capabilities beneficial for organizing financial tasks and data.
